title: sorbus scandica var. mougeotii
intro: Sorbus scandica var. mougeotii, commonly known as the Alpine Whitebeam, is a deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine to promote health and wellness due to its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus scandica var. mougeotii include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
